title: Insegnanti si diventa
summary: The volume outlines the internship experiences developed by numerous Teacher Education Degree Courses arising after the D.M. 249/2010, which established the Master's Degree Course in Primary Education. The individual essays develop the contributions presented in the International Conference "Insegnanti si diventa", organized by the Department of Educational Sciences "G. M. Bertin" (Bologna, 1-2 October 2015).
